evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) is identified and an origin/organization entry for the same referent/time is provided, distinguishing content from its organization/access.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to a content's organization/access in the text.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red/blue sets) and their values for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content values and an origin/representation status for the same referent, distinguishing identification from organization/access.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/inheritance fields state how contents are organized/presented/accessed for named referents (current and candidate).
